Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com — A brief jobs-report update says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant presents itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired spot serving traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. It highlights rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your page clearly identifies it as your personal website and makes your contact email easy to find. I think adding a short biography, your interests, or examples of your work would help visitors get to know you and give them more reasons to explore.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking as your favorite hobby gives the blog a personal touch. I’d love to see that expanded with trail stories, photos, and practical tips such as route difficulty and what to bring. That would make the blog more engaging and useful for fellow hikers.
